issues.message: The Security NFR (users only access their own tasks) and the database users table with email and password_hash imply sign-up and login, but no requirements feature, user story, or design screen covers registration, login, or logout.
The New Task design shows a title character counter of '0 / 100' while the tasks.title column is varchar(255) and the requirements state no maximum, so the limit is inconsistent across artifacts.

required_fixes: Add an authentication feature (register, login, logout) to the requirements and matching screens to the design, or explicitly document how users are identified and authenticated, so per-user task isolation can work.
Align the title maximum length across the design counter (100), the database column (varchar(255)), and the API validation, and state the chosen limit in the requirements.
recommendations: Make the empty-state copy depend on the active filter (for example 'No active tasks' for Active) instead of only 'No completed tasks yet', and add a delete-success toast to the design.
Use consistent status terminology ('Open' vs 'Active') across badges, filter chips, and requirements, and use a dedicated back-arrow icon instead of the 'home' icon for Back.
Drop the redundant plain index on users.email, since the UNIQUE constraint already creates one, and add a database or API rule that completed_at is set only when is_completed is true.
